==Part 1: Starting Out in Varlamore==
<div class="mw-collapsible">{{Checklist|
* Open the Leagues Menu
* Complete the Leagues Tutorial
* Claim first relic (I'm going [[Endless Harvest (Demonic Pacts League)|Endless Harvest]]) *turn off auto bank for now*
* Turn off your Run and back on
* Collect Dramen Staff from league tutor
* Pickpocket a [[Citizen]] (to level 5 [[Thieving]])
* Go inside house to the east, fill [[Bucket]] at water pump
* Run north, pet [[Renu]]
* Perform the Bow emote near [[Renu]]
* Travel with bird to anywhere
* Cast [[Home teleport]] (might put you in [[Yama's Lair]], leave to [[Varlamore]] again)
* Run west, attack dummy to level 8 [[Attack]] 
* Run to [[Bazaar]] (market), cry near a [[Child (Civitas illa Fortis)|child]]
* Thieve full inventory of [[Cake]]s (need 14+)
* Run northwest to [[Fortis General Store]]
* Sell 1 CAKE AT A TIME for maximum GP (not 5, 10, or 50), need 260+ gp 
* Buy 1 [[Knife]], 1 [[Chisel]], 1 [[Spade]], 2 [[Bird snare]]s
* Run south to clothing shop, buy [[Pink skirt]], [[Brown apron]], [[Red cape]] (red cape is 2gp, others are 32gp)
* Run straight south of general store to southern [[Varlamore]] wall. Kill rat w/ bow
* Run east to altar, Salute next to [[Statue of Quoatlos]] (southern)
* Run next to Altar, activate [[Thick Skin]]
* Run east, pet [[Xolo]] outside near [[Bird bath]]
* Drink from [[Bird bath]]
* Chop (or punch) 2 trees (Barbarian Gathering should get 15+ WC here)
* Burn 1 log, fletch 1 log into arrow shafts 
* Run to east bank, deposit all, withdraw coins 
* Enter [[Fortis Colosseum]], run north and talk to [[Gladiator (Fortis Colosseum)|Gladiator]]
* Exit, run north, talk to [[Port master]] (Sailing)
* Run west and buy 10 [[Bucket of sand]], 10 [[Soda ash]], [[Glassblowing pipe]] from charter
* Run south to furnace, make 10 [[Molten glass]], deposit at bank
* Run back to charter, buy 10 more [[Bucket of sand]], 10 [[Soda ash]]
* Run to furnace, make 10 [[Molten glass]] again, blow all glass into [[Empty oil lamp|oil lamps]] for 20 [[Crafting]]
* Run to bank, deposit oil lamps, withdraw [[Bucket of water]] (empty it, keep bucket), [[Air rune]]s and [[Mind rune]]s, [[Dramen staff]] (equip), [[Spade]], [[Pot]]
* Run west to crafting shop, buy [[Shears]] 
* Run south of Varlamore from the bank
* Pick 6 [[Cabbage]] (drop)
* Kill 1 [[Chicken]], pick up bone
* Run just south of the cabbage field and sit emote by the [[Stolen cabbage]] (near dogs)
* Run west, pick [[Sweetcorn]] (drop)
* Give [[Molossus]] bones (north/northwest of sweetcorn)
* Run west, pick and eat 1 [[Onion]]
* Run west, pick 6 [[Wheat]] (keep 1) (drop 5)
* Make [[Flour]] in the windmill to the south-east (can drop flour)
* Run northwest to [[Ortus Farm]], pick 6 [[Potato]]s (drop)
* Buy [[Rake]] from [[Harminia]] (farming patch), rake [[Flower patch]]
* Run north, milk [[Dairy Buffalo|Buffalo]]
* Run west, shear 1 [[Alpaca]]
}}
</div>
